method: pdftotext -bbox: per page its size and, per column, the label (first word) of each line; first_line_top_pt (how far the first line's top sits below the 36 pt top margin) is 2.03 on EVERY non-blank page, so no page starts with a blank line

pages.note: A05 has pageBreakBefore mid-page: it opens page 2
A15 has pageBreakBefore but already opens page 3: it stays (no blank page). The empty paragraph holding only a page break follows A17 HERE (its paragraph mark stays on this page)
A18 follows the empty page-break paragraph: it opens the page with no blank line above it. A19 ends in a page break
A20 follows A19's trailing break: it opens the page, no blank line (A19's paragraph mark leaves no line here). A21a/A21b are ONE paragraph split by a page break
the text after a mid-paragraph page break opens the next page
two-column section: the empty column-break paragraph stays in column 1 after B03; B04 opens column 2
the text after a mid-paragraph column break opens the next column, here column 1 of a new page
oddPage section whose next page (9) is already odd: no blank page
Word's blank page: D is oddPage and the next page (10) is even
evenPage section whose next page (12) is already even
Word's blank page: F is evenPage and the next page (13) is odd
